title: M2 v2 Per-Day File
description: Schema for data/<trip>/days/day-NN.json. M2 introduces this per-day file boundary (Q3a). Each file holds one day's 6 named activity slots + accommodation slot, day-type, stage, and arrival/departure timestamps. NO {primary, alternatives[]} legacy shape allowed; LEGACY_SHAPE_FORBIDDEN raised by validator.

schema_version.description: Bound to v2 contract; bump only on incompatible change.

city_id.description: Canonical city identifier (slug). Matches options' city_context.city_id when role=overnight.

leg_index.description: Index into the trip itinerary's leg list. Same city across consecutive days shares one leg_index.

stage.description: §5.2 per-day planning state. Forward-only within session (undo deferred per Q3d). Editing a finalized day demotes only that day + invalidates adjacent route_cache and transportation segments.

arrival_ts.description: Local arrival timestamp on this day (ISO 8601). Required when day_type in {arrival, city-change}; null otherwise.

departure_ts.description: Local departure timestamp on this day. Required when day_type in {departure, city-change, red-eye}; null otherwise.

slots.description: The 6 named time-slots (§5.8). Every slot key MUST be present even when slot.skipped=true; this prevents silent omission.

accommodation.description: Orthogonal accommodation slot (one per night). selected_option_id may be auto-locked from prior day when same-city continuation (§5.7 B).

intra_city_routes.description: Lazy-populated by /api/route on user drag-drop (§5.9). NOT pre-computed at plan time. Keys are 'from_option_id:to_option_id:mode'.

warnings.description: Non-fatal validator/agent warnings to render in UI.

$comment: Cross-slot rules NOT expressible in pure JSON Schema (per-day meal floor >=6, first-night accommodation >=3, day-type tolerance, state-machine gating, LEGACY_SHAPE_FORBIDDEN substring detection on options[]) live in scripts/lib/trip_contract.py and are run by scripts/plan-validate.py --v2 mode. JSON Schema covers shape only.

_legacy_shape_marker.description: Internal marker; if a JSON document has top-level 'primary' or item-level 'alternatives' keys, scripts/lib/trip_contract.py raises LEGACY_SHAPE_FORBIDDEN. JSON Schema cannot do anywhere-deep negation cleanly, so this is enforced in code.
